# Assets/ThirdParty (not in git)

Background / prop packs imported into this folder are **not committed**: the repository is public and
most of these licenses allow use in games but not redistributing the raw pack files.
Only this README is tracked. The original downloads live on the home PC at `D:\BlindGunfightAssets\<PackName>\`.

To rebuild this folder on another PC: download each pack from its page below (all are free:
"Download Now" → "No thanks, just take me to the downloads"), then in Unity use
Assets → Import Package → Custom Package for `.unitypackage` files, or unzip into
`Assets/ThirdParty/<PackName>/`.

| Pack | Creator | Page | License (as stated on the page) | File | Size |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Gravefield Cemetery Kit — Dark Corners | EmaceArt | https://emaceart.itch.io/cemetrydarkcorners | Free for personal and commercial projects, no credit required | GravefieldCemeteryKitFREEDarkCorners-2026-06-4--10-53-21.unitypackage | 167 MB |
| PS1 PSX Alone in the DUSK | EmaceArt | https://emaceart.itch.io/alone-in-the-dusk-psx-environment-asset-kit | Free for personal and commercial projects, no credit required | PSXAloneInTheDuskEnvironmentAssetKit-2026-10-10.unitypackage | 358 MB |
| Roadside Tales — Fences and Wall Bundle (LODs) | EmaceArt | https://emaceart.itch.io/roadside-tales-fences-and-wall-bundle-pack-1-3-lods | Free for personal and commercial projects, no credit required | LowPolyMeadowBarrierBundleFencesWallswithLODs-2026-23-1--11-52-28.unitypackage | 7.2 MB |
| FREE Analog Memory — 80s/90s CRT VHS Rooms | EmaceArt | https://emaceart.itch.io/free-1980-midpoly-retro-rooms-free-low-poly-3d-model | Free for personal and commercial projects, no credit required (page also lists CC0) | Free1980MidPolyRetroRoom-2025-31-12--16-54-59.unitypackage | 23 MB |
| Cartoon Car Megapack (free part) | RG Poly | https://rg-poly.itch.io/cartoon-car-megapack | CC0 1.0 | Free Cars.zip | 2.1 MB |
| Free Stylized Explosives AAA | RG Poly | https://rg-poly.itch.io/stylized-explosives-aaa | Assets CC0 1.0, code MIT | Stylized Explosives.zip | 180 MB |

All packs are from the itch.io "Creator Bundle Volume 1" free section: https://itch.io/b/3905/creator-bundle-volume-1
